author: Neuralink
description:
Imagine not hearing your loved one’s voice for 4 years due to ALS… and then having that voice restored. Witness the story of Ken & Cheryl, and how Neuralink has restored their ability to communicate… in Ken’s OG voice.

Watch their full story here: https://youtu.be/u8mmn9lOIyw

Note: Neuralink devices are investigational and are not commercially available or FDA approved. There are no guaranteed benefits from participating in a Neuralink clinical trial.
title: Restoring Communication With Telepathy
